metadataReview.note: Reviewed start date: 3 September 1632, directly given for fighting at Alte Veste in the University of St Andrews SSNE record. Replace the imported 9 September start. No end date is asserted by this correction: the separate 4 September active period in CDB90 has not been independently established here, so that quantitative source remains held. The municipal museum confirms the engagement and opposed commands. This start-date correction does not certify a one-day duration or the tabulated force totals.
